c0-frame.imperative: Cycle 2 = refine on the user's focus bits from the cycle-2 reaction pass (audio, 2026-07-17): (1) estimator consolidation architecture (staged math->physics->precise vision, feedback loop, sigma honesty); (2) FP fits #513 shape (mass, lap representativeness, sandbag robustness, driver-utility/car-performance decomposition); (3) feature seam v1 (physics features replace raw timing; NN end-state, direct-BT prototype); (4) affinity artifact (corner fingerprints; car vs driver split); (5) ordering/critical path to 601 round-1 by summer break. c0-frame.finding: Flavor = refine (user: 'focus in on the stuff that matters to me, hone the plan to 601'). Focus bits: estimator consolidation (staged vision), FP fits #513 (biggest concern), feature seam v1 (physics replaces raw timing; NN end-state), affinity artifact (car/driver split), ordering to summer-break round-1. q1.title: Critical path: does FP-fit work wait on the estimator consolidation?
q1.imperative: The plan's shape hinges on whether #513 FP fits proceed on the CURRENT five-view estimator (with honest sigma) while the staged consolidation runs behind, or whether consolidation is a prerequisite. Ask with recommendation; record answer as finding.
q1.finding: DECIDED: do not serialize; #513 FP fits = FIRST CONSUMER of the consolidated architecture's stage-1 (coarse math model + honest sigma designed once for Q AND FP). Guideline adopted by user: BUILD THE ARCHITECTURE TO SOLVE THE HARDEST PROBLEM. Fallback if calendar pressure: throwaway SQ probe to de-risk signal existence.

q2.title: Round-1 (summer break) scope: what ships, what waits
q2.imperative: Pin the minimum deliverable for 601 round-1 by summer break: which features, which injection path, which eval gate; where affinity lands. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q2.finding: ROUND-1 SCOPE DECIDED: ignore the calendar - right things at the right time, arrive at the endpoint in the best state. Round 1 = create the MOST BELIEVABLE AND HONEST FEATURES (stage-1 consolidated model over Q+FP, honest sigma, car affinity via corner fingerprints, direct-BT prototype injection, A/B vs gold). NN-on-physics-features = round 2 (confirmed). Driver-utility split confirmed: PRODUCE in stage 1, CONSUME in round 2. 2026 = best-effort inflated-sigma posture.

q3.title: The v1 feature vector: what are the believable honest features, concretely
q3.imperative: Pin the round-1 per-car-per-weekend feature vector contents and their honesty metadata. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q3.finding: V1 FEATURE VECTOR: five-axis list (power-to-weight, aero efficiency, grip/traction, braking, circuit-conditional composite) + composite-only BT injection accepted as working hypothesis - no axis objections. NORMALIZATION = OPEN QUESTION: user concern with relative-to-field - it links pooling across all teams, and slow-moving performance components then need multiple weekends of data to resolve. Possibly right, worth EXPERIMENTING. Standing theme: test ideas, find the tractable data; not rushing, driving to results; windy road fine if direction is right.

x4.title: Excursion x4: normalization stability probe (absolute vs relative-to-field)
x4.imperative: Background research+compute excursion; brief excursions/x4-normalization-brief.md. Record scoped verdict on return.
x4.finding: NORMALIZATION PROBE: weekend-relative (car minus weekend field median) beats absolute on ALL 11 axes, no exceptions - noise SD 49-85% of absolute (median 0.59x), weekends-to-resolve ~3x fewer (median ratio 0.35). Power + drag benefit most (~0.49-0.52; shared rho/altitude systematic cancels - the 4% SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR mechanism), brake-aero-slope least (0.85). Realistic 0.3-field-sigma development step: relative resolves in ~4-18 weekends (often within-season) vs absolute ~9-52 (season+). Coast already well-behaved absolute (powertrain-dominated) but still improves. USER CONCERN ANSWERED: relative-to-field does NOT slow slow-moving-component resolution - it speeds it ~3x, because weekend common-mode confounds dominate the noise. Caveats: within-season only (team renames), noise conflates jitter with real development (conservative), 2026 thin. Scoped to current five-view Q store, not a redesigned stage-1. Script: excursions/x4-analysis/normalization_stability.py (1562 ok rows, 81 car-seasons).

x5.title: Excursion x5: sprint SQ evidence verify
x5.imperative: Background research excursion; brief excursions/x5-sq-evidence-brief.md. Record scoped verdict on return.
x5.finding: SQ EVIDENCE: USED - doc's fear stale. get_practice_session_types returns [FP1,SQ,S] for 2022+ sprint weekends; _split_run_buckets hardcoded sprint branch routes FP1+SQ laps to qs_* (quali-sim bucket, consumed by live quali module) and S laps to lr_* (long-run). SQ reaches the quali module AND the anchor. S used only as long-run pace; the doc's secondary S->Q 0.730 signal NOT exploited as its own quali feature (seam: DRIVER_QUALI_POWER_FEATURE_NAMES, size S-M, small-n caveat 21 sprint weekends). Loose end: sq_pos/s_pos classification positions populated but only feed the RETIRED stage-2 form path - likely dead weight like fp*_pos (not exhaustively checked across recent_history modules). Data on disk confirmed (2025 R2 China: 217 SQ laps, 380 S laps). Scoped: code-truth on current main; no git-history dating; historical gold bundles not checked.

x6.title: Excursion x6: circuit-demand artifact readiness
x6.imperative: Background research excursion; brief excursions/x6-circuit-demand-brief.md. Record scoped verdict on return.
x6.finding: CIRCUIT-DEMAND ARTIFACTS: NOT sufficient today - scoped build gap, not dead end. Fingerprint artifacts were built for TYRE-WEAR panel diagnostics (src/physics/wear/), a different pipeline than the capability vector (src/physics/layer2/); geometry columns (shed_pct=braking, gain_pct=traction, headroom_pct=flat-out) are legit starting material. Gaps: no per-corner TIME-weighting (M); straights untabulated (M); no lateral-g/radius axis - damage_integrals.db grip_bin_obs (measured mu_lat_p90) is the better foundation (M); corner_matches cross-year mapping only 9 gps x 3 years (L); fingerprint 'label' is a wear-sensor tag NOT a regime tag (S relabel); coast_frac is per-driver racecraft, DROP from demand inputs; the actual deliverable - per-circuit regime time-share rollup - unbuilt anywhere (L). Building blocks exist: segment_classifier.py already classifies per-sample straight_brake/straight_throttle/coast/corner but is never aggregated per circuit; circuits.yaml has hand-tagged downforce:1-5 that a measured profile would upgrade. Scoped: read-only audit; no join was prototyped.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 2 (refine) consolidated. Decisions: hardest-problem-first architecture (stage-1 coarse model + honest sigma designed once for Q AND FP; #513 = first consumer); round 1 = most believable/honest features via direct-BT prototype injection (composite scalar only), NN-on-physics-features + driver-utility consumption = round 2; ignore calendar; 2026 = inflated-sigma best effort. Feature vector: power-to-weight, aero efficiency, grip/traction, braking + circuit-conditional composite; driver utility produced-not-consumed. Empirics: x4 weekend-relative normalization wins all 11 axes (~3x faster slow-component resolution) -> relative vector canonical; x5 SQ already used (doc fear stale; optional S->Q feature backlogged); x6 circuit-demand = unbuilt but tractable via segment_classifier per-circuit rollup (fingerprint artifacts are wear diagnostics; label/coast_frac traps named). Remaining opens = spec-level: stage-1 interface (design-it-twice), FP representativeness mechanics, demand-rollup shape, prototype A/B details, 2026 sigma posture. Board current.
